topic: Flaky daemon tests seen while verifying SP-013
detail: TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks (internal/daemon/taskwatch_test.go:117, 'WatchTasks ended with context canceled') fails about 1 run in 4 on origin/main 644dcaf as well as on the SP-013 branch (5/20 and 6/20 with -count=20). TestCallerSessionCost failed once (p99 5.5 ms against a 5 ms bound) while a 16-worker fuzz run loaded the CPU. Neither touches SP-013's code. Fix the first; consider making the second tolerant of a loaded machine or skipping it under -short. The SP-013 verifier also saw TestRunMeasuresFailedRuns (internal/agentrun) fail twice on the branch under full-suite load (DurationMS 199 against a 200 ms timeout; never on main in 7 full and 20 isolated runs; the package is untouched by SP-013) and TestToolHookCost once (passes in isolation, p99 about 14 ms against 30 ms). Both look load-sensitive. Update 2026-11-09 (SP-014 session): full internal/daemon runs failed on TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks 3 of 3 times on origin/main 0ff06db and 2 of 3 on the SP-014 branch (0 of 20 each when run alone), so under full-package load it now fails most runs. Update 2026-11-09 (SP-017 session): full internal/daemon runs failed on TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks ('WatchTasks ended with context canceled') 1 of 2 on origin/main 85b0784 and 6 of 6 on the SP-017 branch (passes alone); TestRunMeasuresFailedRuns (internal/agentrun, untouched) failed once in a full go test ./... and passed alone. The handler appears to return ctx.Err() instead of nil when the client goes away under load. Update 2026-11-09 (SP-015 session): TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks failed 2 of 20 isolated runs on both origin/main cf031dc and the SP-015 branch, and in 3 of 5 full go test ./... runs on the branch (a fourth failing run's test was not captured); TestRunExitsWhenANewBuildIsInstalled (internal/daemon run_test.go:120, 'grpc: the server has been stopped') fails 3 of 3 under go test -race on both main cf031dc and the branch (CI does not run -race). In CI on PR #157 (run 42753605190, attempt 1) TestRunMeasuresFailedRuns failed again (DurationMS 199 against a 200 ms timeout) and passed on the re-run. Update 2026-11-10 (SP-016 session): in CI on PR #164 (run 42877529008, attempt 1) TestToolHookCost failed differently from before: 998 of 1000 events taken, but some attributed to no session ('' instead of sess-hook), i.e. a hook caller resolved as unidentified under load; it passed on the re-run and 8 of 8 local runs. The test builds its own gRPC server and the SP-016 diff does not touch that path. Worth investigating as a possible intermittent caller-resolution bug, not only a timing flake.
